test_title: PYST 25: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 18 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing out to the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). P is sitting second to the left of U. R is sitting third to the right of S. S is an immediate neighbour of V. V is sitting to the immediate left of P. T is not an immediate neighbour of U.

How many people are sitting between P and Q when counted from the right of P?
solution:
Given, P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are sitting around a circular table facing out to the centre (but not necessarily in the same order).

P is sitting second to the left of U.

V is sitting to the immediate left of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b47ea783e262661d315d598eda00ee7886118fcc241f8fe2ba14d179d347f8e6.png] 

R is sitting third to the right of S.

S is an immediate neighbour of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca394dd14132d73a399f7665d855db21aa910284122292edad13f90839ee1954.png] 

T is not an immediate neighbour of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f70b3e0f1fe4484aa8446d051fbb6f8a1925f22141f53ae72b72fa283e6fd20.png] 

And Q sits at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/512773af25b9cf33eb751d159e205ff5eb408a6d081af948bdb6a31d9fe3572e.png] 

Two people are sitting between P and Q when counted from the right of P.

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**
